If sentiment is positive and forecast is below recent low, add 2–5% to forecast for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is above recent high, subtract 2–5% from forecast for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast deviates >3% from 30d moving average, adjust toward moving average for late horizon (16–30 days).  
When sentiment swings from positive to negative, reduce forecast slope by 15–30% in mid horizon.  
If sentiment is consistently positive over 5+ days, increase forecast by 1–3% per day for early horizon.  
If sentiment is consistently negative over 5+ days, reduce forecast by 1–3% per day for late horizon.
